title: CubeSat Vehicle (Custom Pointing)
text: Model CubeSat vehicle whose primary alignment vector points towards center of Earth, {Camera field-of-view (FOV) half angle (deg)} sets Half angle of field of view, and so does the port count; {Start date [Julian date]} sets the initial start date of simulation, {Input method} sets the initial vehicle Keplerian, {Epoch of ECI frame [Julian date]}, {Semi-major axis [m]} sets the cubeSat semi-major axis, {Eccentricity} sets the orbital eccentricity, {Inclination [deg]} sets the tilt angle of CubeSat orbital plane, {Right ascension of the ascending node [deg]} sets the angular distance in equatorial plane, {Argument of periapsis [deg]} sets the angle from CubeSat body ascending node, {True anomaly [deg]} sets the angle between periapsis and current position, {True longitude [deg] (circular equatorial)} sets the angle between x -axis of periapsis and position of CubeSat, {Argument of latitude [deg] (circular inclined)} sets the angle between ascending node and satellite position, {Longitude of periapsis [deg] (elliptical equatorial)} sets the angle between x -axis of periapsis and eccentricity, {ECI position vector [m]} sets the cartesian position, {ECI velocity vector [m/s]} sets the cartesian, {ECEF position vector [m]} sets the cartesian position, {ECEF velocity vector [m/s]} sets the cartesian, {Geodetic latitude, longitude, altitude [deg, deg, m]} sets the geodetic latitude and longitude, and altitude, {NED velocity vector [m/s]} sets the body velocity, {Initial Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) [deg]} sets the initial Euler rotation angles, {Initial body angular rates [deg/s]} sets the initial angular rates, {Pointing mode} sets the cubeSat vehicle pointing mode Earth, {Primary alignment vector (Body wrt B CM )} sets the primary alignment vector, {Secondary alignment vector (Body wrt B CM )} sets the secondary alignment vector, {Constraint coordinate system}, {Primary constraint vector (wrt B CM )} sets the primary constraint vector, {Secondary constraint vector (wrt B CM )} sets the secondary constraint vector, {Analysis run time source} sets the source of run time for mission analysis live script, {Run time [sec]} sets the run time for mission analysis live script, {Ground station geodetic latitude, longitude [deg, deg]} sets the ground station location, {Run TOI analysis} enables time of interest mission analysis, {Time of interest [Julian date]} sets the time of interest for mission analysis live script, {Live script file name} sets the file name for mission analysis live script report blank and {Create Live Script Report} sets the analyze mission and create live script report. Values come from the instance.
